items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: we'd take Pop’s fake books... No, my father went up to — I forgot the guy’s name... Anyway Pop went up to him

ctx.x: What would have happened, I think Pat said that he gave me a little anecdote and he discovered improvising because he couldn’t see the music to play the written out solo.

Yeah the Ted Mack Amateur Hour audition — or there was a contest at one of the — I can’t remember what it was but it was at a county fair and they had a contest and we entered it. And Pat, I guess the music either blew away or he couldn’t see it. And he had that — that was an epiphany because he made it up. And then we realized that that was a thing. But you know there was no books, there were no books at that period like you can get today. So we would try to copy — we didn’t try we did, we copied solos off the…
You were doing like second year jazz education. I mean that is such great ear training to discover that on your own.
